title: Web3 infrastructure hero: one glow, big proof numbers and notched tiles (NixtNode)
attribution_visible_in_image: Brand name 'NixtNode' in the mockup; no creator credit visible.
contains_third_party_content: Chain/token logos and portrait photos in the avatar row.

observed.layout: Lavender page with a large rounded dark container. A radial glow runs from pale lavender (center) to near-black (edges). Top: mono-font logo and uppercase mono nav (Services 7, Team 9, Networks We Support 35) with tiny superscript counts. Headline '} NixtNode / Is a Premier Web3 Infrastructure Provider' in a right-aligned stack, with the 'o' of 'Provider' drawn as two overlapping rings tied to a thin orbit ellipse crossing the composition. Right: a short mono paragraph and a black pill 'GET IN TOUCH'. Bottom: dark tiles with concave corner cut-outs merging into the frame, two huge lavender numerals ('192k Assets under management', '34 Unique delegators'), connector lines with end dots, and a row of chain logos and avatars.
observed.hierarchy: Headline, then the two proof numerals, then the CTA.
observed.typography: Large grotesque headline in dark ink; monospace for logo, nav and body. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Chain logos and avatars as small circles.
observed.materials: Radial gradient glow, dark rounded container, inverse-corner tiles, thin orbit line.

interpretation.aesthetic: Soft-tech 'ethereal infrastructure': mono type and tiny counts say engineer; glow and orbit say network.
implementation_notes: Radial gradients for the glow; SVG for the orbit ellipse and the ring 'o'.
Notched/inverse-corner tiles via masks or pseudo-elements.

concept_work.essence: One glow for focus, huge proof numbers as the second read, one action.
what_makes_it_work: Glow gives depth with no image.
The stats are the biggest type after the headline, so proof is unmissable.
Merged tiles make the footer part of the frame.
The ring 'o' ties the headline to the orbit graphic.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Mono body copy measures about 3.24-3.35:1 on the glow.
Stat labels measure about 7.6-9.65:1 (small white on dark).
Text color flips between white on dark corners and dark ink on the light glow, so transition zones need checking.
The orbit line crosses text; no states are shown.

shared_tokens: large corner radius and inverse-corner notch
links: Tile numerals reuse the glow's lavender.
Connector dots link the two stat tiles.
The ring 'o' belongs to the orbit line that crosses the whole composition.

approach: Radial gradients plus an SVG orbit
risks: Contrast across the glow's transition zones

pattern.name: Glow hero with proof tiles
use_when: B2B infrastructure or finance-adjacent offers that need trust numbers
avoid_when: The audience reads on low-brightness or high-glare screens without checking the light/dark text swap
adaptation_examples: Fintech: glow in brand green, stats for transactions and uptime.
Dev tool: glow in blue, stats for GitHub stars and users.
failure_modes: Small mono text on the glow

lessons: Make proof numbers the second-largest element of a B2B hero.
Check text color where it swaps between light and dark regions.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Lavender page and glow, near-black container, ink headline on the light glow, white or lavender text on dark.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: Offer, proof and one action are clear.
One focal glow, strong type scale, restrained palette.
Landing conventions (headline states the offer, one CTA, proof) are met.
Only the default state is shown; small text and tiny superscript counts.
Mono and grotesque pair, radii and lavender ramp are applied throughout.
The ring 'o' tied to an orbit line and notched proof tiles are distinctive.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 7.42:1; secondary text min 3.35:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
